_help: Task Launcher data. Edit freely, then run: python aero/apply-aero.py. Each task needs category, name, description, editor (document | spreadsheet | presentation) and template. template is either "builtin:<name>" (a template that ships with the app, matched by its display name) or a file path relative to aero/launcher/ (e.g. "templates/letter.docx"). thumbnail is optional: a path relative to aero/launcher/. Built-in templates use the app's own preview when it's missing.
